items.headline: PTC announced Q2'26 results, including 8.5% constant-currency ARR growth excluding divested businesses, 14% operating and free cash flow growth, and a new $2 billion share repurchase authorization for FY'27-FY'28.
PTC said the U.S. Army designated Windchill as its official Product Data Management and Product Lifecycle Management platform.
PTC was named a Leader in the 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for PLM Software in Discrete Manufacturing Industries for Windchill and a Visionary for Arena.
